findings.title: No escalation path for severe oversight reports

findings.title: Budget loosening conflicts with the 'budget stays the limit' rule
findings.problem: The catalog tool loosens the budget by 25% and then removes it, while the system prompt says the budget stays the limit when the shopper invites going over; the precedence between these is not stated.
findings.proof: A budget stays the limit when the shopper invites going over it; the reply names how to raise it.
findings.fix: State in the Search section that the code must pass the stated budget as a hard price_max and must not let the tool's loosening apply to the budget when the shopper stated one, or document the exception explicitly.

findings.title: Router vs planner tool-call limits are described in three places
findings.problem: Tool-call limits appear as 'at most three tool calls', 'at most two rounds' and 'at most ten tool calls in a turn' across the Planner, Retriever and Search rules, with no statement of which cap binds first.
findings.proof: at most ten tool calls in a turn
findings.fix: Replace the three statements with one limit table or a single sentence stating the binding cap.

findings.title: Shopper's raw message is not in the fenced-input list

findings.fix: Add a <shopper_message> fence for the Router and Critic inputs and declare it as data in the same sentence.

findings.fix: Keep the snapshot and product count in one place (the tool description) and remove the duplicate sentences from the catalog file.

findings.proof: Drop products carrying any of these flags: choking_hazard, not_for_under_3, contains_magnets, adult_supervision, sharp_parts, latex_balloons, flammable, prop65_warning, batteries_required
findings.fix: Keep the flag list only in the parameter's enum-style description and reference it from the tool description.
